comment: A Doepfer web page (copied from doepfer.de/a1011_tec.htm) with two principle circuits: the A-101-1 vactrol Steiner filter and the A-106/MS20 filter. Neither has designators, so each note says which circuit the part is in. The two 'R' resistors are OTAs in the real module.

A-101-1: two frequency vactrols and one resonance vactrol
A-101-1: op amp, no part number given
A-106/MS20: 'R', realized by OTAs in the MS20
A-106/MS20: anti-parallel limiters; no part number given
